positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
I wear a lot of different hats here: 

In my primary role, I design, implement, & deploy asynchronous and authenticated solutions primarily using React+Redux, ASP. NetCore, message brokers, Redis, Azure Active Directory, and microservices architecture

For another department I act as a product manager and dev team to create and implement high value user stories that I put together - one of which reduced our risk exposure by ~$360,000 per year.

I'm also a mentor, legacy system bug fixer, service designer, contact for our internal customers and more.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
In my current project, I am developing web APIs that utilize a variety of AWS cloud services and have collaborated with my peers to create flexible cloud service architecture.
Previously, I spearheaded the development process, and became a subject material expert for a COTS integration project. While developing, I was also responsible for updating technical documentation and leading meetings to ensure the coordination between several different teams in different companies.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: I aided in programming a board using an ARM processor for a stationary hand cycle in C and designing information flow between the chips on the hand cycle. Later work was largely using an programming and arduino to communicate with AWS cloud services for prototyping functionality, e.g. storing user workout data, FOTA, and API support.
